title: Ship a change
blurb: Make a worktree, change a file, review it, and open a pull request.

greet: Hi. From a new branch to a pull request, in a few steps.
Let us make a worktree and ship a small change.
finish: Branch, change, review, pull request. You shipped it.

steps.title: Make a worktree
steps.note: A worktree is a second checkout of the project on its own branch.
steps.hint: ctrl+b, then U (shift and u). A dialog asks for a branch.

steps.title: Name the branch
steps.note: tuios makes the branch and the folder, and opens a pane in it.
steps.hint: Type a branch name, such as shout, and press enter.

steps.title: List the worktrees
steps.note: The new pane is in the worktree. The prompt shows its branch.
steps.hint: Type git worktree list and press enter.

steps.title: Change a file
steps.note: An agent does this part on a real machine. Here you add a line.
steps.hint: Type echo "Ship it." >> README.md and press enter.

steps.title: Review the change
steps.note: ctrl+b v shows the change against main. q closes it.
steps.hint: ctrl+b, then v. Look at the change, then press q.

steps.title: See the ship steps
steps.note: tuios ship lists the steps from this worktree to a merged change.
steps.hint: Type tuios ship and press enter.

steps.title: Commit the change
steps.note: tuios ship commit commits every change on the branch.
steps.hint: Type tuios ship commit -m Docs and press enter. -m is the message.

steps.title: Open a pull request
steps.note: tuios ship pr pushes the branch and opens a pull request. In the demo, nothing leaves here.
steps.hint: Type tuios ship pr and press enter.

web.note: tuios ship pr pushes the branch and opens a pull request. In the demo, nothing leaves the tab.
